items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: from Jack Kerris, we were playing once, an advertisement on a Sunday, for a dance over in Gretna

ctx.x: Is that existing today or the high of the world? No, it's not.

Oh, no. Oh, no. So, from Jack Kerris, we were playing once, an advertisement on a Sunday, for a dance over in Gretna, while we'd play mostly every Sunday night, called the Come Clean. We'd make an advertisement on Sunday. On the wagon. On Monday. Yeah, on the wagon. So, I remember one Sunday, on the corner of 8th and Howard, a gentleman called me out the wagon. Which, he lived on 8th Street. It was a row. And he lived in one of the rows. His name was Ike Jackson. Bass violin player. Oh, he played for Tom Anderson…
What is the last name? Mac?
